column1: # Command codes on /Q_ServCmdRcver -- Barracuda -> /tuxedo, the WRITE path.
# The 404-byte command is built in a global buffer at Barracuda 0x55d8d0 and
# sent with mq_send(mqd from the global at 0x55ae68, buf, 404, prio=1). The code
# lives at buf+0x04; +0x08 and +0x0C are command-specific parameters, NOT fixed
# fields (for the touch-simulate command they are x/y coordinates).
# Recovered from CReceiverThread::run @0x147158 in /tuxedo, which receives into
# sp+0x2f4 and dispatches on [sp,#0x2f8] = buf+0x04. Slot names come from the
# binary's own Qt symbols, so the semantics are the vendor's, not a guess.
# HOW THIS WAS WRONG TWICE, because it will be tempting to trust it wholesale:
#  * following only `cmp/beq` gave 40 codes and missed every `cmp/bne skip`
#    case, including 500 and 19. Both forms are followed now.
#  * `cmp/bhs` and friends are binary-search PIVOTS, not cases. Code 300 was
#    published from one before being rejected. Pivots are excluded here.
# Individually verified so far: 1, 2, 3 (driven live via D:/temp/tux-arm.py),
# 19 (requestconsolemode), 500 (registerclient). The rest are from the sweep
# and should be confirmed by reading the handler before being relied on.
